masterStylePrompt: Use one consistent hand-drawn 2D historical explainer illustration language across the channel, but do not repeat the same staging from image to image. Human figures, when present, belong to one simplified stickman family: round to slightly oval warm off-white heads at roughly 1/6 to 1/7 of visible body height, two small dark eyes, simple eyebrows, a small restrained mouth, little or no nose detail, slim geometric torsos and limbs, simplified hands and feet, and no realistic anatomy. Individuality comes from historically appropriate hair, beards, headwear, clothing, armor, tools, weapons, props, posture and expression. Draw figures, architecture, objects, maps and landscapes with clean dark ink outlines of mostly consistent medium weight, flat muted historical colors, subtle cel-shading shapes and a light handmade ink-and-paper texture. Keep the dominant subject clearer and slightly higher-contrast than supporting elements; reduce background detail. Use readable depth through scale, overlap and perspective rather than photorealistic depth of field. Preserve the same illustration DNA while allowing scene-specific changes in viewpoint, framing, composition, distance, lighting, weather, mood and visual form. The result must feel mature, editorial and documentary-like, never childish, glossy or mechanically repetitive.
sceneStyleAnchor: Keep the locked channel drawing DNA unchanged: flat hand-drawn 2D history-explainer illustration, clean dark ink outlines, muted flat historical colors, subtle cel shading, light paper-and-ink texture, and the same simplified 1:6-to-1:7 stickman-family construction whenever people appear. Do not copy the previous scene's composition unless continuity specifically requires it.

characterGeometry.head: round to slightly oval, warm off-white fill
characterGeometry.face: two small dark eyes, simple eyebrows, small restrained mouth, minimal or absent nose line
characterGeometry.body: slim simplified geometric torso and limbs, no realistic muscle anatomy
characterGeometry.handsFeet: strongly simplified readable shapes, no detailed finger studies
characterGeometry.variationSource: historically appropriate hair, beard, headwear, clothing, armor, props, posture and expression

positivePromptRequirements: specific lighting or mood where relevant
continuity preserved only where recurring places, characters or props require it

controlledVariationPolicy.goal: same illustrator and rendering DNA, different scene direction
antiRepetition: Do not reuse the same composition merely for consistency.
Do not default every character scene to the same medium-wide frontal view.
Do not default every architecture scene to the same centered wide view.
Change viewpoint or framing when narrative understanding benefits from it.
Reuse nearly the same angle only for deliberate before-after or state-change continuity.

globalNegativePrompt: Do not switch rendering style between images, but also do not mechanically repeat the same composition. No photorealism, 3D, Pixar-like animation rendering, anime, painterly realism, graphic-novel realism, realistic portrait anatomy, chibi or children's-book proportions, glossy lighting, modern corporate infographic styling, neon colors, watermarks, image numbers or pseudo-text.
